title: 中国人的夏夜④完结·酸梅汤：最家常的解暑饮料，曾是清宫御膳的方子 | Summer Nights P4 · Sour Plum 🥤

虾、烤、冰、酸——你的夏夜，第一口先选哪个？评论区排个序。

【中国人的夏夜 第4集·完结 酸梅汤】这碗最家常的解暑饮料，其实出自清宫御膳房。它本是太医院的药方——用乌梅取其"收敛"，配上冰糖、桂花，人称"乌梅饮"，乾隆爷赐它"清宫异宝，皇家御饮"的名号。再往前，宋末元初周密的《武林旧事》里就记着它的前身"卤梅水"。乌梅、山楂、桂花、冰糖，一熬一晾，酸甜生津。老北京的夏天，就是这透心的一口凉。用北京话说：倍儿敞亮，得嘞！

虾、烤、冰、酸——一个中国夏夜的四味，到这儿就齐了。

Ep.4 (finale) Sour plum drink. China's homiest summer cooler actually came out of the Qing imperial kitchen. It began as a court-physician's recipe — smoked plum (wumei) for its astringency, with rock sugar and osmanthus, known as the "wumei tonic"; the Qianlong Emperor dubbed it "a treasure of the palace." Earlier still, the Song-era Wulin Jiushi records its ancestor, "lu mei water." Smoked plum, hawthorn, osmanthus, rock sugar — boiled, cooled, sweet-sour and reviving. This is old Beijing's summer in one cold sip. Crayfish, grill, ice, sour — a Chinese summer night, complete.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Folk-custom & culinary-history note, not medical advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
